title: Generative engine optimization examples: 4 AI engines compared
body_md:
:::answer
SEO is not dead with AI, it has split in two. Google still ranks pages, while AI engines like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews pick which business they quote in an answer. A study found nearly 40% of web traffic now comes from non-traditional discovery methods, so pages written only for keyword rankings miss a growing share of buyers.
:::

:::takeaways
- SEO is not dead, it has split into ranking on Google and getting quoted in AI answers.
- Nearly 40% of web traffic now comes from non-traditional discovery methods, per DigiMarCon's case study.
- Generative engine optimization means writing pages that directly answer buyer questions, not just targeting keywords.
- AI search tools now track engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot.
- ReachKit writes and publishes pages for both Google and AI answers from €49 a month.
:::

## Is SEO dead now that AI answers questions directly?

SEO is not dead, but it no longer works alone. Search moved from blue links to AI-generated answers, and a page built only to rank on Google can still miss the buyers who ask ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews instead, as described in [SEO Is Not Dead, But AI Search Just Changed the Rules](https://digimarcon.com/seo-is-not-dead-but-ai-search-just-changed-the-rules-a-case-study-of-ai-search-and-generative-engine-optimization/). The same study found a large share of traffic now arrives outside the traditional search click, so a page written for one channel leaves money on the table.

## What is generative engine optimization?

Generative engine optimization is writing pages so an AI engine can lift a direct answer from them and name your business while doing it. It is the same instinct as SEO, answer the question clearly, but aimed at a model summarising a page rather than a crawler ranking it. Our own page on how to rank in AI Overview for your business covers the mechanics in full.

## What are examples of generative engine optimization in practice?

A GEO example is a page that opens with a plain two-sentence answer to a buyer's exact search, then backs it with a fact, a price or a named source, the format AI engines quote most easily. Tools built for this job track which AI engines mention a brand: Otterly AI tracks all 7 major AI search engines across more than [65 countries and languages](https://otterly.ai/features), and Peec AI's Starter plan tracks activity across [3 chosen models with daily frequency](https://peec.ai/pricing).

## Which AI search engines get tracked?

The engines buyers use most are ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot. Otterly AI's Lite plan names exactly this set: [tracking of 4 AI search engines: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and MS Copilot](https://otterly.ai/pricing). Profound's enterprise tier goes further, offering [up to 9 answer engines tracked](https://www.tryprofound.com/pricing) for teams running marketing agents at scale.

## Do I need to track AI mentions and rankings separately?

Yes, because being quoted in an AI answer and ranking on Google are two separate outcomes that need separate checks. Peec AI's Starter plan bundles [50 prompts, 3 models and daily tracking for one project](https://peec.ai/pricing), built for teams starting on AI visibility specifically, while Google ranking still depends on the technical and content checks SEO always ran. Treating them as one job is how pages fall behind on both.

## How does ReachKit handle SEO and AI visibility together?

We work on getting your business found on Google and in AI answers, from one subscription rather than two separate tools. ReachKit researches your business and competitors, then writes up to 7 pages a week, new or updated, with Google and AI tracking included, all from the [pricing page](https://reachkit.app/pricing) at €49 a month, tax included. You get one Monday email on what went live and what moved, and a free scan first so you see who Google and AI pick instead of you before you pay anything.
